title: Balanced Accuracy
description: Mean of sensitivity (true positive rate on physiological interfaces) and specificity (true negative rate on crystallographic interfaces) at a decision threshold, correcting plain accuracy for class imbalance. Threshold is the published threshold reported for the scoring function when available; otherwise the data-driven optimal threshold (Youden's J statistic) is used.
formal_definition: Balanced Accuracy = (TPR + TNR) / 2, TPR = TP/(TP+FN), TNR = TN/(TN+FP)
